I don't think there's anywhere you can buy tons of commons and
uncommons. you could try lasombra's site:
http://members.tripod.com/~Lasombra/
he sells cards so you could probably pick up quite a few there.

It's worth buying a box of DS. As Derek said the vampires are very
useful. i think the camarilla vampires in DS are better than the ones
in AH. DS is the only set that released the Inner Circle members (11
point vampires) and some of them are game winners. DS also has some
extremely useful cards that the camarilla bunch can use e.g.

Aire of Elation
Banishment
Heidelburg Castle
Pentex Subversion
Legendary vampire
Thoughts Betrayed
Toreador Grand Ball

Look them up on white wolf's site. i'm sure they'll whet your appetite.

AH also has some generally useful cards but instead of paying the
exorbitant amounts a box goes for these days you could trade for these
cards at the succubus club http://vampire.tne.net.au/

Dreams of the sphinx - rare and valuable (hard to trade for)
kiss of ra - uncommon and pretty good
parthenon - common to uncommon (although it's listed as rare at the
site, it's not really, i've got tons)
signet of king saul - rare but fairly easy to trade for
blood to water - common and useful
atonement - common and very useful

Sabbat has some good cards but you might as well wait for the new
expansion (due on Oct 31) in which many of the sabbat cards will be
reprinted.

OZ? - Australia.

theventrue

if you want any more information send me an email and i'll give you a
more detailed breakdown of which cards are useful and what they're
worth when trading.
chr...@comcen.com.au
